section.para: Returns true if the connection on which the message was received is TLS, the peer presented an X509 certificate and the certificate chain verified ok.
It can be used only in a request route.

example.title: is_peer_verified usage

section.para: Set the server id of the tls profile to be used by next client connect, being reset after use. It is an alternative to the use of xavp to specify server id of a client profile for the cases when xavps are no longer available (e.g., after event_route[tm:local-request]).
If the parameter is an empty string, then the value is reset.
It can be used only in ANY_ROUTE.

Set the server name (SNI) to be used by the next client connect, being reset after use. It is the server_name counterpart of tls_set_connect_server_id(), for the cases when xavps are no longer available (e.g., after event_route[tm:local-request]). It is also the name checked by the verify_server_name attribute of the client profile.

It is used only when the server id of the connection is the one set by tls_set_connect_server_id(), and only when the server_name attribute of the xavp is not set. A value left over by a request sent on an existing connection is not used by a new connection whose server id is given by the xavp.
If the parameter is an empty string, then the value is reset.
It can be used only in ANY_ROUTE.
